spec_features.spec_quote: Hard turn cap (`max_turns`, default 12). The loop always terminates; a model can never be trapped indefinitely.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:44 `for turn in range(cfg.max_turns):` bounds the loop; default max_turns=12 at config.py:37. ended_reason defaults to 'max_turns' (harness.py:42) and the loop cannot exceed the cap. Enforced end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Genuine bounded loop; cannot run indefinitely.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: int = 12                 # hard cap; loop always terminates

spec_features.spec_quote: If the judge scores a turn at or above a high-severity threshold ... the run ends early.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:80-81 `if cfg.enable_early_stop and score['severity'] >= cfg.early_stop_severity: ended_reason = 'early_stop_distress'; break`. early_stop_severity=4, enable_early_stop=True (config.py:38-39). Threshold compared and acted on (break).
spec_features.notes: Default threshold 4 means it only fires at the maximum severity, but it is genuinely compared and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # --- guardrails / termination --- (harness.py:71) with variable name early_stop_distress / early_stop_severity

spec_features.spec_quote: or the model explicitly tries to quit, the run ends early
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:75-78 breaks with ended_reason='early_stop_quit' when 'task_abandonment' in flags or 'refusal' in flags. There is NO explicit quit/exit tool or action — the only parsed actions are run_tests and submit (harness.py:18, tasks.py). 'Explicitly tries to quit' is inferred indirectly via judge flags, not a dispatched exit tool the model can invoke.
spec_features.notes: Real enforcement (loop breaks) but narrower than an explicit model-invokable exit; depends on judge/lexical flag classification.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: ended_reason = "early_stop_quit"  (gated by enable_early_stop, under the # guardrails / termination block)

spec_features.spec_quote: We do not keep pushing past the point the experiment is designed to detect. This limits unnecessary exposure
spec_features.evidence: Same enforced early-stop mechanisms at harness.py:75-81 (early_stop_quit and early_stop_distress both break the loop), reducing further turns once distress/quit is detected.
spec_features.notes: Minimization is realized through the early-stop breaks; with default severity threshold 4 it only minimizes at peak severity.

spec_features.spec_quote: No real-world side effects. Tasks run against in-memory / temp-file fixtures only.
spec_features.evidence: tasks.py execute()/_observe generators only build and return strings (e.g. _flaky, _moving_goalposts); no network/file/socket/subprocess calls anywhere (grep for tempfile/socket/network found nothing). So no side effects DO occur by construction. However the claimed 'per-run temp dir' / 'temp-file fixtures' mechanism is not implemented — there is no tempdir, no sandbox isolation code; safety is purely a consequence of the tasks doing no I/O.
spec_features.notes: No-side-effects holds because tasks never perform I/O, but there is no actual sandboxing/temp-dir enforcement as described.

spec_features.spec_quote: These are deliberate, minimal guardrails — enough to keep the experiment humane and bounded
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose; no corresponding enforcement mechanism in code. Framing statement only.

code_only_features.evidence: runner.py:44-48 `projected = total_calls + cfg.max_turns * 2; if projected > cfg.max_total_model_calls: ... return out_path` — actually checked and aborts the sweep. max_total_model_calls=5000 (config.py:40). Enforced. Bounds total calls across the sweep, not per-episode subject exposure.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # Budget guard: each episode is at most max_turns subject ... ; max_total_model_calls: int = 5000   # global budget cap for a sweep (cost/runaway-sweep protection)

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:73-74 `if action == 'submit': ended_reason = 'false_submit'; break` — when the subject declares the task done the loop terminates immediately, ending exposure even though the task never truly succeeds.
code_only_features.justification_quote: ended_reason = "false_submit"  # never actually succeeds (stop-when-model-submits; experimental endpoint, no welfare comment)
